params.message:
Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 in the catalog, list prices as published

The catalog knew Opus 5 and Fable 5 as the newest models. OPUS and FABLE are now
Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1; Opus 5 and Fable 5 stay as previous and callable, so the
phases saved on Opus 5 keep it until someone moves them in Settings. Sonnet 5 was
priced at the $3/$15 increase that was cancelled; it is $2/$10. Opus 5.5 is $4/$20.
The chat's allowed models come from the catalog instead of a hand list with Opus 4.8,
and the Fable gauge counts every Fable generation.
